text:
Ibrahim: Quick postmortem follow-up from the multi-region failover — want to lock owners on the verification gates we missed and the downstream action items before next rehearsal.

Sofia: Summary: two recurring issues — stale route entries preventing full steer, and inconsistent snapshot manifests when replication overlaps. I've attached the runbook diffs here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dr-verification-diff.

Ken: I'll own the verification gating work: explicit pre-cutover gate that fails if steering sample != 95%+ in 60s window. ETA 2026-04-11.

Rita: I will own manifest hardening (atomic mark + checksum+count). Small service to verify before marking snapshots ready. ETA 2026-04-03.

Ibrahim: Ops, can we reserve a 90-min dry-run window next Wed for the full verify+restore sequence? @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: Calendar: staging dry-run reserved 2026-03-31 14:00-15:30 UTC. Invites sent to @oncall, Ken, Rita, Sofia.

Sofia: Canonical action list to import to GH project (label: dr-verif-ai):

```
AI-701 | Pre-cutover steer gate (95% in 60s)      | owner: Ken   | due: 2026-04-11
AI-702 | Snapshot atomic mark + verifier           | owner: Rita  | due: 2026-04-03
AI-703 | CI regression: route-staleness sim        | owner: Ken   | due: 2026-04-08
AI-704 | Game-day checklist: add mirror-sample     | owner: Sofia | due: 2026-03-29
AI-705 | Warm-standby rough cost + ops checklist   | owner: Ibrahim | due: 2026-04-05
```

Ken: I'll submit the steer-gate PR and add a small synthetic traffic job to CI to validate in staging.

Rita: Manifest verifier will include a short retry window (tunable) to handle eventual consistency. I'll open GH issue and link PR.

Sofia: Also enabling incident label "dr-verif" for quick queries and a weekly digest to #incidents so trends surface.

infra-bot: Incident 2026-03-29-MRFAIL: closed. Follow-ups created: 5. Digest scheduled: every Monday 09:00 UTC.

Ibrahim: Finance ping: can someone sketch ballpark monthly for warm-standby snapshots + minimal compute so we can include in the proposal?

Ken: I'll draft a quick ballpark and ping finance, deliverable EOD Fri.

Sofia: We'll review AI status in next DR sync. Owners: post a one-line blocker update here if you miss a due date.

Ken: Acknowledged.

Rita: PR + issue links will go here when ready.

Ibrahim: Thanks all — closing thread unless blockers appear.
